headline: Going Commando gains level handlers and a way to link compiler-generated constants
summary: Going Commando adds C for level movement, effects and state handling, including Siberius, Damosel Orbit, Snivelak, Notak, Maktar, Tabora and Joba. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Techniques adopted from Ratchet & Clank allow verified compiler-generated constants to link and help previously blocked reconstructions match (#318, #319). The committed progress report is unchanged from the previous day and does not yet reflect these new merges.
highlights: Catalogue repairs correct callable starting points across USA v1.01, USA v2.00 and Europe/Australia while leaving excluded prefixes in assembly (#314, #315).
#316 classifies 27 bodies as original assembly. This changes their labels rather than adding C implementations.
Vector, control, beam-rendering and target helpers land across the releases that contain them (#320, #321, #322, #323, #324, #325).
#326 repairs existing call interfaces and retains 39 large reconstructions, but explicitly adds no newly matched functions.
Snivelak path motion matches for USA v1.01 and USA v2.00 in #327. Europe/Australia has no corresponding catalogue entry.
